description: Declared platform matrix for the self-contained sap-adt runtime. 'status' is maintained explicitly: 'verified-local' and 'verified-ci' require a real native build + install smoke on that OS/arch, locally or in CI respectively. Never mark a target verified from a script's existence alone.

windows-x86_64.notes: Windows x64 runtime built with Windows Python 3.12 via WSL interop; ZIP and real npm global-prefix install smoke verified locally on 2026-10-29. Inno Setup 6.7.4 desktop installer: silent per-user install, same-version upgrade, launch and uninstall verified in a Unicode/space path with the PATH task disabled; PATH cleanup helper tested separately. Interactive wizard, actual PATH mutation and elevated install are unverified. No Windows assets published by these checks.

linux-x86_64.notes: Verified on Ubuntu 24.04 glibc 2.39 (WSL2). glibc floor applies to other distros; do not generalize to musl/older glibc without a real build there.

darwin-aarch64.notes: Experimental macOS 15+ Apple Silicon runtime. Native macos-15 CI with Python 3.14 passed the full offline Python/npm suites, runtime build and isolated npm runtime installation: Actions run 40881012113, source e1e0bb056fc0c2b3e25989e8e02996d292f8605d. No personal Mac, older macOS, live SAP, Keychain, Gatekeeper/quarantine, signing or notarization verification.
